name: Daily supply/demand zones from ATR impulses, fresh-touch entry on 4H
author: darkosedam-svg (swingforge)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Daily zones + 4H entries; Hyperliquid tournament in repo (FX/crypto).
entry_long: Daily impulse = close-to-close move >= 2.0 x ATR(14) within <= 3 daily bars; zone = full [low, high] of the last opposing-colour daily candle at/before the impulse start. A zone stays fresh until the first 4H bar after its birth overlaps it; enter at zone midpoint when a 4H bar closes inside a fresh zone (signal expires after 3 bars): demand -> long, supply -> short.
entry_short: Supply zone first touch with a 4H close inside -> short at zone mid.
exit: Target = nearest daily swing level (swing highs for longs / lows for shorts, k=2) beyond the mid; structure target may be None.
stop_loss: Demand: zone low - 0.25 x ATR(14 daily); supply: zone high + 0.25 x ATR.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Freshness (first touch only), newest 20 zones, optional round-number filter
implementation_notes: Source docstring reports internal engine details; no performance numbers captured. Spec is code-derived and nearly complete.
